observations: Black game console with a blue DualShock 4 controller.
A handwritten note is taped to the top of the console.
The console has a 'PS4' logo on the top right corner.
The controller has a 'PS' logo on the center button.
The screen is off in the photo.
The console appears to be sitting on a wooden surface.

claims.evidence: The console looks clean in the photo, but usage history cannot be confirmed remotely.
No games are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or have a faulty screen.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware issues (e.g., overheating).
risks.proof: A video showing the console running for several minutes without overheating.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Video of the controller being used to navigate menus.
Photo of the back of the console showing the ports.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
